title: Region omen (reads "Something stirs in <region>: <omen>") — a whole tract escalating

entries.value: the land itself seems to hold its breath
war-drums echo from every direction after dark
refugees stream out of the interior with only what they can carry
the birds have gone quiet, and the roads with them
smoke hangs over the horizon for days on end
shrines are found defaced, their keepers fled
no caravan has come through in a fortnight
the militia has stopped patrolling the far tracks
the wells and springs are said to have turned foul
every hamlet tells of something moving at night
old boundary stones have been thrown down
